say: A weekly content system, AI with a human check, and safe images.
This is the video for module 4 of Content Creation with Canva and Phone Tools.
Most small businesses post when they remember, then go quiet for weeks, and customers forget them. A content system turns this into a weekly routine of about two to three hours.

say: Step one. Choose three to five content pillars, the themes you post about again and again. For a bakery: products and offers, tips, behind the scenes, happy customers, and community.

panel.heading: Build your weekly content system
items: Decide a pace you can keep

say: Step two. Be realistic. Three feed posts or Reels a week, plus daily WhatsApp Status, is a sensible start.

panel.heading: Build your weekly content system
items: Decide a pace you can keep

say: Step three. Plan a weekly calendar in a notebook or a Google Sheet. Note market days, salary week, Sallah, Easter and Christmas a month ahead.

panel.heading: Build your weekly content system
items: Decide a pace you can keep

say: Step four. Batch. Shoot all your photos in one daylight session, and design all your posts in one Canva session with your master templates. You set up only once.

panel.heading: Build your weekly content system
items: Decide a pace you can keep

say: Step five. Spend ten minutes a week recording reach, saves, messages and sales. Make more of what works.

say: For example, Fatima, a tailor in Ilorin, spends about three hours a week. Her sheet showed that her measuring tip brought appointment requests, so she now plans one tip every week.

say: Generative AI creates text or images from your instructions, called prompts. A weak prompt like, write a caption for my cake, gives a generic answer.

panel.heading: Weak prompt, strong prompt
left: Write a caption for my cake
right: Tone, and the action to end with

say: A strong prompt has five parts: who you are, the audience, what you want, the format, and the tone. For example: I run a home bakery in Ibadan. Write three captions under 50 words for a red velvet cake, for mothers planning parties. Warm and simple.

panel.heading: Weak prompt, strong prompt
left: Write a caption for my cake
right: Tone, and the action to end with

say: Here is a worked example. Folake writes a strong prompt for three bags, for women going to owambe parties, ending with WhatsApp to order.
She gives the AI her real prices: about 15,000, 18,500 and 22,000 naira. It returns nine captions, and she picks three.
Then the human check. One caption said the bags were waterproof. They are not, so she deletes it. She rewrites each in her own words, with a Yoruba greeting she really uses.
Three captions in about 15 minutes, with no false claims.
AI can state things that sound confident but are false. This is often called hallucination. Check every fact yourself.

panel.heading: Three AI rules to protect you

cards.d: AI can sound confident and still be wrong. Check prices, dates, laws and health claims.
Never show AI images as real products or real results. Customers will feel cheated.
Never paste customers' names, numbers or account details into AI tools.

say: Use real photos for products. If customers buy because of an AI picture, they will be disappointed and may report you.

say: Never paste private customer data into AI tools. And beware of apps promising AI that will make you rich for an upfront fee. Never share your social media passwords with them.

say: Place your product beside a window, with light from the side. Cover direct sun with a thin white curtain.

panel.heading: Free light, clean photos
items: Gridlines and the rule of thirds

say: Hold a sheet of white cardboard on the opposite side to lift dark shadows.

say: Avoid the flash. It flattens the subject and causes harsh shadows.

say: Turn on gridlines and place the product on a third line. Clean the background, and walk closer instead of zooming.

say: One rich video can become a Reel, Status clips, a carousel, a quote graphic and a caption. For the pictures, use your own photos, Canva's free items, Unsplash or Pexels. With Creative Commons, give credit, and avoid NC, which means no business use.

panel.heading: Images you may and may not use

say: A photo on Google or someone's Instagram is not free just because you can download it. In Nigeria, copyright falls under the Copyright Act 2022.
When in doubt, leave it out.

panel.heading: Images you may and may not use

say: To remember. Pillars, a steady pace and batching. AI drafts, you decide. Side window light, no flash. One core piece, many formats. And only images you are allowed to use.
